headline: Classical and tropical bonsai styling, taught by a working demonstrator: turning hesitant growers into confident artists who make the big cut without fear.
revenue_headline: $30,000 estimate per cohort: one premium apprenticeship, 20 spots at $1,500 (about 2.8% of your ~718 most engaged followers)
summary: Ten-page audit for Veer Choudary: public-data snapshot and three content pillars, the 14,362 x 5% = 718 -> 20 spots x $1,500 = $30,000 working, a three-product ladder, offer detail, the six-phase launch tied to his Mysore/Vadodara/Ahmedabad workshops, the audit's test carousel and a closing page. Prices kept in US dollars because the audit uses $ (vibe suggested INR); the $60,000 ceiling (two cohorts a year), the Blueprint ($197, 1-3% of 718 = 7-21 buyers) and the Diagnostic ($1,800, 3-6 clients) are our labelled estimates since the audit priced only the apprenticeship. Pillar post figures come from the audit text, which differ from the scraped profile numbers; headline stats use public profile data.
